observation: Fresh main treats rootGoal as the mission's stable closure target while nextGoal is the explicitly evolvable per-cycle derivative, yet generic update() could replace rootGoal with any other non-blank string. That allowed an in-place mission write to change the long-term target without creating a new mission identity.
changes: Reject update patches that attempt to change rootGoal away from its persisted mission value.
Permit an explicit identical rootGoal for compatibility and keep nextGoal independently evolvable.
Add focused regression coverage for rejected root-goal drift and valid next-goal evolution.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: a different non-blank rootGoal passed validMissionShape() and was persisted by generic update().
verification.post_fix_contract_replay: PASS: rootGoal drift is rejected before mutation; same-value rootGoal plus a changed nextGoal remains accepted.

truth_boundary: This cycle preserves the existing rootGoal/nextGoal role split. It does not define a new mission-retargeting workflow or forbid creation of a new mission with a different root goal.
